title: Book Two · Chapter 168: Before the Question
story:
On Tuesday afternoon, Ronan waits outside the reading room. He holds his folder close to his side. Inside, Miss Wu talks with two younger students about a torn book cover.

He can wait until they finish. He has time before his next lesson.

The younger boy shows the loose page. Miss Wu looks at the edge and asks for the book card. Ronan hears her voice through the doorway.

He takes the small unfinished note from his folder. Miss Wu. The fourth.

The words look foolish alone. He folds the note into a small square.

Mei comes along the path with a ruler. She needs to return it to the room.

“Are you waiting for Miss Wu?” she asks.

“I was looking for my paper.”

“She is nearly free.”

Ronan puts the note away. “I need to go back.”

He leaves before the younger students come out.

At home, Mum has a customer beside the table. A dark coat lies between them. Mum explains the work on one sleeve. The customer moves her arm inside the coat. Mum asks her to reach toward the far side of the table.

“Like this?”

“Yes. Can you move freely now?”

The woman tries again. Mum watches the sleeve rather than the woman's face. Then she makes a small mark on her own note.

Ronan waits by the doorway. He wants Mum to look up and see that he needs to talk.

She turns toward him, but the customer has another question. Mum answers it and gives the coat her attention again.

Ronan touches the edge of his folder. He can wait until the customer leaves. There is no reason to interrupt her.

He puts the folder against his side. Mum is telling the woman when to come back. She checks the time in her book before she gives an answer.

Ronan says hello and goes to the kitchen.

There are three small biscuits on a plate. He eats one slowly. He wants the second, but he leaves it for Mum. The third has a broken corner. He turns the plate and looks at the empty space beside the two biscuits.

Mum comes in after the customer leaves.

“You can have another,” she says.

“One is yours.”

“I have a whole bag in the cupboard.”

He laughs a little and takes the broken biscuit.

She makes tea and sits beside him. “You look tired.”

“The practice record is up.”

“You told me about the last task. Is there something else?”

Ronan breaks his biscuit in half. “It says I can take the final tasks.”

Mum looks surprised. “I thought you needed four.”

“Yes.”

“Did I misunderstand?”

He looks at her cup. “I need to check one mark.”

“Then check it.”

He says nothing. Mum waits, then gets up to put the coat away. She does not smile or congratulate him. He has not told her about the wrong mark yet.

Ronan takes his folder out after tea. The fourth paper is still inside. He lays it flat, writes the full task number on the small note, and stops again.

Near evening, he hears Mum laugh in the other room. A friend has come to the door with news. Ronan listens for a moment. Then he returns to his page. He can still speak tomorrow. For now, he puts the note under the folder and carries his empty cup to the kitchen.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

torn＝撕破的；sleeve＝袖子；misunderstand＝误解；congratulate＝祝贺。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan原本有什么说清事实的机会，又怎样离开了？
2. Mum为什么没有直接祝贺他进入最终选拔？

## 读句子

**He has not told her about the wrong mark yet.**

拆开看：He / has not told her / about the wrong mark / yet.

他／还没有告诉她／那个错误的记号。
